21230: The anime will explore the childhood bond between Luffy, Ace and Sabo.
L'anime esplorerà il legame infantile tra Luffy, Ace e Sabo.
21294: Shigure finds herself assigned to the 1st Striking Force 3rd Division for an important upcoming operation along with a surprising variety of other Fleet Girls. What will their role in the next big offensive against the Abyssals be?

Shigure si trova assegnata alla prima divisione della 3a forza in movimento per un'importante operazione in arrivo insieme ad una sorprendente varietà di altre Fleet Girls. Quale sarà il loro ruolo nella prossima grande offensiva contro gli Abissal?
21422: Yuzuka Hanami is a young girl who has few friends but who can do anything. One day, Yuzuka gets accosted by a strange creature named Miton who is digging through a trash dump. Miton tells Yuzuka, "you have the makings of a magical girl" and seems extremely suspicious. When Yuzuka is suddenly transformed into a magical girl, she's wearing a bathing suit.

Yuzuka Hanami è una giovane ragazza che ha pochi amici ma che può fare qualsiasi cosa. Un giorno, Yuzuka viene aggredito da una strana creatura di nome Miton che sta scavando in una discarica. Miton dice a Yuzuka: "Hai la stoffa di una ragazza magica" e sembra estremamente sospetto. Quando Yuzuka si trasforma improvvisamente in una ragazza magica, indossa un costume da bagno.
21486: With four-frame comic origins, this animated title preserves the same quick pace by following the regular cast of colorful characters through separate but interwoven story lines in every episode. From Ms. Shitara's relentless but always ineffective sexual pursuit of young Takagi to the adventures of the heroicly stupid but cute Sushi Cat, you will be mystified at the silliness of it all but find yourself laughing for the same reason!
21678:
Shorts of Ansatsu Kyoushitsu (TV) 2nd Season which adapt chapters of the manga which are not in the TV series.

The adapted chapters are 78 ("Takebayashi no Jikan") and 79 ("Shihaisha no Jikan, Ni Jikanme"), which are published in the ninth manga volume.

Pantaloncini di Ansatsu Kyoushitsu (TV) 2nd Season che adattano i capitoli del manga che non sono nella serie TV.

I capitoli adattati sono 78 ("Takebayashi no Jikan") e 79 ("Shihaisha no Jikan, Ni Jikanme"), che sono pubblicati nel nono volume manga.
21742: The year is 1863, the tumultuous samurai era is coming to an end. Japan is split between the pro-shogunate and anti-shogunate factions. The fate of the world is threatened as an army of historical revisionists are sent from the future to alter the course of history. In order to bring these forces down and protect the real history, two sword warriors, spirits who are swords brought to life by Saniwa (sage), rush to Edo with a lively gang of warriors to confront the invaders.

L'anno è il 1863, l'era tumultuosa dei samurai sta per finire. Il Giappone è diviso tra le fazioni pro-shogunate e anti-shogunate. Il destino del mondo è minacciato come un esercito di revisionisti storici sono inviati dal futuro per modificare il corso della storia. Al fine di abbattere queste forze e proteggere la vera storia, due guerrieri di spada, spiriti che sono spade portati in vita da Saniwa (sage), correre a Edo con una banda vivace di guerrieri per affrontare gli invasori.
21806: The Yowamushi Pedal: Spare Bike spinoff manga series follows the early years of the third-year students.
97966:
The country of Khura'in doesn't have attorneys. Instead, the outcome of trials are decided by the oracles.

Meanwhile, in Japan, Naruhodo Ryuichi receives a disturbing call from his old friend, Mayoi Ayasato, who is currently training in Kurain.
98094: The episode follows Ren on his vacation in Okinawa. There, he meets a mysterious girl.
98222:
A bombing case at Nichiuri TV in autumn. The Satsuki Cup, which crowns the winner of Japan's Ogura Hyakunin Isshu based competitive karuta tournament, is currently being filmed inside the facility. The incident results in a big commotion and, while the building is burning to ashes, the only people left inside are Heiji and Kazuha. They get rescued just in time by Conan, who rushes to the scene. Both the identity and motive of the bomber are unknown.

While confusion takes over due to the explosion, Conan meets a mysterious beautiful girl who claims she is "Heiji's fiancée". Her name is Momiji Ooka and she is the Kyoto High School karuta champion. As fate would have it, Kazuha is going to face Momiji in the Hyakunin Isshu competition, so she begins to train with the help of Heiji's mother, Shizuka, who is a skilled karuta player.

At the same time, in a Japanese house in Arashiyama, Kyoto's outskirts, the reigning Satsuki Cup champion is murdered. Pictures of the crime scene reveal Momji's presence. Additionally, several karuta cards were spread around the victim.

Conan and Heiji, along with the Osaka and Kyoto police departments, begin their investigation on the Satsuki Cup and the related murder case. As the inquiry goes on, they come across a secret connected with the Hyakunin Isshu.

Un caso di bombardamento alla Nichiuri TV in autunno. La Satsuki Cup, che incorona il vincitore del torneo di karuta agonistico giapponese Ogura Hyakunin Isshu, è attualmente in fase di ripresa all'interno della struttura. L'incidente provoca una grande confusione e, mentre l'edificio brucia in cenere, le uniche persone rimaste all'interno sono Heiji e Kazuha. Vengono salvati appena in tempo da Conan, che si precipita sulla scena. Sia l'identità che il movente dell'attentatore sono sconosciuti.

Mentre la confusione prende il sopravvento a causa dell'esplosione, Conan incontra una misteriosa bellissima ragazza che afferma di essere la fidanzata di Heiji. Si chiama Momiji Ooka ed è la campionessa di karuta del liceo di Kyoto. Come avrebbe voluto il destino, Kazuha affronterà Momiji nella gara di Hyakunin Isshu, quindi inizia ad allenarsi con l'aiuto della madre di Heiji, Shizuka, che è un esperto giocatore di karuta.

Allo stesso tempo, in una casa giapponese ad Arashiyama, periferia di Kyoto, il campione in carica della Satsuki Cup viene assassinato. Le foto della scena del crimine rivelano la presenza di Mamji. Inoltre, diverse carte di karuta sono state distribuite intorno alla vittima.

Conan e Heiji, insieme ai dipartimenti di polizia di Osaka e Kyoto, iniziano le indagini sulla Coppa Satsuki e sul relativo caso di omicidio. Mentre l'inchiesta continua, si imbattono in un segreto collegato con il Hyakunin Isshu.
98478:
Now in his second year of high school, Rei Kiriyama continues pushing through his struggles in the professional shogi world as well as his personal life. Surrounded by vibrant personalities at the shogi hall, the school club, and in the local community, his solitary shell slowly begins to crack. Among them are the three Kawamoto sisters—Akari, Hinata, and Momo—who forge an affectionate and familial bond with Rei. Through these ties, he realizes that everyone is burdened by their own emotional hardships and begins learning how to rely on others while supporting them in return.

Nonetheless, the life of a professional is not easy. Between tournaments, championships, and title matches, the pressure mounts as Rei advances through the ranks and encounters incredibly skilled opponents. As he manages his relationships with those who have grown close to him, the shogi player continues to search for the reason he plays the game that defines his career.

Ora, nel suo secondo anno di liceo, Rei Kiriyama continua a spingere attraverso le sue lotte nel mondo dello shogi professionale così come la sua vita personale. Circondato da vibranti personalità nella sala dello shogi, nel club scolastico e nella comunità locale, il suo guscio solitario comincia lentamente a rompersi. Tra loro ci sono le tre sorelle Kawamoto [47], Akari, Hinata e Momo, che forgiano un legame affettuoso e familiare con Rei. Attraverso questi legami, si rende conto che ognuno è gravato dalle proprie difficoltà emotive e comincia ad imparare a fare affidamento sugli altri mentre li sostiene in cambio.

Tuttavia, la vita di un professionista non è facile. Tra tornei, campionati e partite di titolo, la pressione si alza mentre Rei avanza attraverso i ranghi e incontra avversari incredibilmente abili. Mentre gestisce i suoi rapporti con coloro che si sono avvicinati a lui, il giocatore di shogi continua a cercare il motivo per cui gioca il gioco che definisce la sua carriera.
98542:
Yume Nijino is in a pinch!?
A luxury school idol cruise liner called Venus Ark has suddenly appeared!
And the perfect idol who leads this ship is "Elza Forte"!!
While traveling around the world, she gathered the most excellent idols and brands she could find.
And now she has set her eyes on her next target, Yume Nijino of Four Star Academy.
98862: A foxy temptress. A strange misty tree demon. A girl with the power of the goddess Xianjia! Being caught between these women is a feat in it of itself, but our hero Feng Xi must fight in order to protect the peace and save the world!

Una tentatrice foxy. Uno strano demone degli alberi nebbiosi. Una ragazza con il potere della dea Xianjia! Essere intrappolati tra queste donne è un'impresa in sé, ma il nostro eroe Feng Xi deve combattere per proteggere la pace e salvare il mondo!
99054: Unaired episode included with the Blu-ray release, featuring a short snipped of each girl's arc with their clothes replaced with a swimsuit.
Episodio inedito incluso con la release di Blu-ray, con un corto strappato dell'arco di ogni ragazza con i loro vestiti sostituiti con un costume da bagno.
100526: Hikari Tsutsui has never been popular, his one real friend is an even worse otaku than he is, and the only girls he's known are the two-dimensional women from his manga and video games. Until, that is, he's sent to help clean the pool as punishment and is partnered with the school's resident "bad girl", the very real, very three-dimensional Iroha Igarashi. Brash, beautiful, and known for her promiscuous behavior, Iroha is loathed by other girls but loved by the guys. And yet, inexplicably, she not only seems to be interested in Hikari, but proposes that they enter into a relationship! Unable to resist, Hikari agrees, but there's one big catch - Iroha's moving away in six months, so no matter what happens between them, in half a year Hikari's guaranteed to lose his REAL GIRL!

Hikari Tsutsui non è mai stato popolare, il suo unico vero amico è un otaku ancora peggiore di lui, e le uniche ragazze che ha conosciuto sono le donne bidimensionali dei suoi manga e videogiochi. Finche', cioe', non sara' mandato ad aiutare a pulire la piscina come punizione ed e' associato alla "cattiva ragazza" residente nella scuola, l'Iroha Igarashi molto reale, molto tridimensionale. Brash, bella, e noto per il suo comportamento promiscuo, Iroha è detestato da altre ragazze, ma amato dai ragazzi. Eppure, inspiegabilmente, non solo sembra essere interessata a Hikari, ma propone che entrino in una relazione! Incapace di resistere, Hikari è d'accordo, ma c'è una grande presa - Iroha si trasferisce in sei mesi, quindi non importa cosa succede tra di loro, in mezzo anno Hikari ha garantito di perdere la sua vera ragazza!
100910:
A fifth-year elementary student named Eiji Tōmatsu, and his "inspiration" buddy, a dog named Pochirou. One day Eiji finds a mysterious book called the "Pikachin Research Book," and learns about the seven tools that make up the Pikachin Kit. Eiji presses a button inside the research book, and immediately a "Future Amazon" delivery arrives at his door with the kit. Eiji uses the blueprints included in the box to assemble the kit, but it seems as though 1% part of the kit is still missing.

In the franchise, the word "Pikachin" means the flash of inspiration or insight one gets about a new project, similar to the visual of a lightbulb turning on above one's head when someone has an idea. The concept of the franchise is "invention is 99% plastic models, 1% inspiration."
101102: A compilation film of the Ansatsu Kyoushitsu TV series, featuring anime-only epilogue scenes not originally in the manga.
Un film della serie televisiva Ansatsu Kyoushitsu, con scene di epilogo solo anime non originariamente nel manga.
101166: Living above the legendary dungeons of Orario ought to be enough danger for anyone, and in his short time as a member of the goddess Hestia's familia, Bell Cranel has experienced more perils and pitfalls than most. So, when Bell unexpectedly wins a free trip, is it too much to hope that he might have actually won a real vacation? Of course it is! Inexplicably chosen as the champion of Hestia's friend, the goddess Artemis, Bell quickly finds himself up to his neck in ruins and monsters as yet another epic quest begins. And where Bell goes, can the ever-jealous Hestia be far behind?

Vivendo al di sopra dei sotterranei leggendari di Orario dovrebbe essere abbastanza pericolo per chiunque, e nel suo breve tempo come membro della famiglia della dea Hestia, Bell Cranel ha sperimentato più pericoli e insidie che la maggior parte. Quindi, quando Bell inaspettatamente vince un viaggio gratis, è troppo sperare che possa aver vinto una vera vacanza? Certo che lo e'! Inspiegabilmente scelto come campione dell'amico di Hestia, la dea Artemide, Bell si ritrova rapidamente fino al collo in rovina e mostri mentre inizia un'altra epica ricerca. E dove va Bell, la gelosa Estia può essere molto indietro?
101550: Season finale of Wo Shi Jiang Xiaobai: Shijie Shang de Lingyi Ge Wo, confirmed at the end of episode 12.
102062: There's a crisis in the Chinese Spirit World -- humans don't believe in gods anymore! A Door God, facing unemployment, ventures into the human world to prove his worth, leading to unexpected encounters and transformations for humans and spirits alike.
102446: A beauty blogger has been sent to a VR reality game, where she has to stand firm in a catfight in boudoir. But how so? She is given numerous cosmetic products that she can arm herself up with. Based on the popular online novel published on the famous female-oriented online novel website "Jinjiang", this animation is strongly recommended to those who love all kinds of cosmetics.
102510: As part of the imperial family, every move by Chu Yuan in this game of chess is made with apprehension, fearing that with a moment of inattentiveness, the whole match will be lost in a single move. Ascending to the throne at eighteen, not half a year passes before civil strife erupts in Yun Nan. Though the thoughts of the old guard at the imperial court are not exactly identical, they are all waiting to see how the new emperor will put an end to this.
102574:
A boy is always alone, at school, or at home. One day, he finds a sandlot on the way home and thinks of making a ‘town’ of his own. Another boy was watching his play and starts to imitate him.

1st year work 2013, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation
102702: A web anime created for the Dotwan dog food company. The episode illustrates the daily life of a family and their dog.
102766: Director Wataru Uekusa's work for NHK's Educational Television channel. The Techne Tri corner teaches watchers certain features of animation, this video was a part of his rotoscoping lesson.
103342: A cat drums while a group of cats dance to a marching song.
103406: Short film by Mirai Mizue and Onohana with music by Twoth.
103470:
Students in the Tokyo, Osaka and Nagoya branches of HAL College of Technology and Design under supervision and sponsorship by professional mecha designer Takayuki Yanase along with other industry professionals, created a series of 3 web movies to act as commercials.

The three teams—each consisting of 16 members including animators, artists and effect technicians—are working on their own advertisements to display the talent of the students and the subjects one can learn through attending HAL such as game design, anime development and even car design. Each team is drawing from the same design and story to create their own unique commercials. Initially all 3 branches released a 16-sec. CM before each completing the full 39-sec. Web Movie.

Music for each creation is provided by J-rock band MY FIRST STORY.
104174:
Unaired episode included with the volume 6 BD/DVD release of Steins;Gate 0. A special day approaches during a lull in the chaos. It's that time of year to give chocolate to the ones you love, but not everyone finds that an easy task.

With Valentine's Day just around the corner, the girls of the Future Gadget Lab discover that Kagari has never celebrated the occasion before! Determined to make this year's holiday the best one yet, they all set out to make delicious homemade chocolates together.

However, with many of their quirks causing kitchen disasters, this may prove to be too hard a task. Will their feelings ever reach those of their heart's desire?

Episodio di unaired incluso con il volume 6 BD/DVD rilascio di Steins;Gate 0. Un giorno speciale si avvicina durante un lullo nel caos. E' quel periodo dell'anno per dare cioccolato alle persone che ami, ma non tutti trovano che un compito facile.

Con San Valentino proprio dietro l'angolo, le ragazze del Future Gadget Lab scoprono che Kagari non ha mai festeggiato l'occasione prima d'ora! Determinati a rendere la vacanza di quest'anno la migliore ancora, tutti hanno deciso di fare deliziosi cioccolatini fatti in casa insieme.

Tuttavia, con molte delle loro stranezze che causano disastri in cucina, questo può rivelarsi un compito troppo difficile. I loro sentimenti raggiungeranno mai quelli del loro cuore?
104430:
This is a story of a little girl who believes she can hatch an egg one day if she keeps it warm.

1st year work 2015 by Chayanit Kiatchokechaikul, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation.
104558:
According to legends, there are seven ancient artifacts that hold infinite power. An evil force desires to possess them as their own to achieve their hidden plot. Pan Zheng grew up in a village filled with Descendants of Deities, who practice martial arts and worship Zhuque of the South.

In the unseen world of deities, soon they were involved in a conflict over ancient artifacts. Under the guidance of the Zhuque, in order to fight back against the evil forces, Pan Zheng passes through millennium of years to the present and made many friends. To seek out the ancient artifacts, they set off to travel across Shenzhou (an old name for China, the Divine Land).
104750: One day while going to high school recuperative classes, Junpei notices a weird rock which he then decides to carry with him; but during classes the rock started talking! "You guys are the heroes of the prophecy! I want you to get rid of the devils of destruction." Suddenly a bright light shined from the rock and when they woke up they weren't at school anymore, they were transported to a world of animation! Afterwards they get challenged by a Sphinx that appeared out of nowhere, if they can't solve the Sphinx puzzles they will not be able to come back to the real world. Can these 5 return to the 3 dimensional world?
106286: High school student Hodaka leaves his home on an isolated island and moves to Tokyo, but he immediately becomes broke. He lives his days in isolation, but finally finds a job as a writer for a shady occult magazine. After he starts his job, the weather has been rainy day after day. In a corner of the crowded and busy city, Hodaka meets a young woman named Hina. Due to certain circumstances, Hina and her younger brother live together, but have a cheerful and sturdy life. Hina also has a certain power: the power to stop the rain and clear the sky.

Lo studente del liceo Hodaka lascia la sua casa su un'isola isolata e si trasferisce a Tokyo, ma diventa subito al verde. Vive i suoi giorni in isolamento, ma finalmente trova un lavoro come scrittore per una rivista occulta ombrosa. Dopo aver iniziato il suo lavoro, il tempo è stato piovoso giorno dopo giorno. In un angolo della città affollata e affollata, Hodaka incontra una giovane donna di nome Hina. A causa di certe circostanze, Hina e suo fratello minore vivono insieme, ma hanno una vita allegra e robusta. Hina ha anche un certo potere: il potere di fermare la pioggia e liberare il cielo.
106542: Another short bonus included in a Blu-ray/DVD disc of μ's live concert that took place in Saitama Super Arena on February 8th and 9th, 2014.
106606:
A parody opening for a spin-off of Gakkougurashi!, starring the characters from the visual novel Tokyo Necro by Nitro+.

The animation was released by Nitro+ as an April Fool's prank, complete with an official website announcing a full TV series. The website was closed shortly after.
106862: As one of the Lords of the Clock Tower as well as the department head of the Modern Magecraft Theories department, Lord El-Melloi II holds yet another lecture for his diverse array of students. After the post-lecture meeting with other Clock Tower nobility, he throws out a few insults at the fellow Lords that are interested only in their internal power struggle, but he quickly receives a counter-curse in retaliation. On the following day, while in transit with his apprentice Gray, he notices a cat ran over by a car. It's the stray cat that frequently visited his room as of late. Lord El-Melloi II realizes that this was an attempt to take his own life, and commences a perpetrator hunt along with Gray, Flat and Svin.

Come uno dei Signori della Torre dell'Orologio e capo dipartimento del dipartimento di Teorie Magecraft Moderni, Lord El-Melloi II tiene un'altra lezione per la sua variegata schiera di studenti. Dopo l'incontro post-lezione con altre nobiltà della Torre dell'Orologio, lancia alcuni insulti contro i signori che sono interessati solo alla loro lotta di potere interno, ma riceve rapidamente una controcursa in rappresaglia. Il giorno seguente, in transito con il suo apprendista Gray, nota un gatto investito da un'auto. E' il gatto randagio che visitava spesso la sua stanza ultimamente. Lord El-Melloi II si rende conto che si tratta di un tentativo di togliersi la vita, e inizia una caccia al carnefice insieme a Gray, Flat e Svin.
109102: In 2004, Liang Xuan produced a flash short film which was the prototype of the animated film Da Yu Hai Tang, which won the DIGIID Award of Intel 2004 China Digital Festival.
109358: A short film by Takuya Aikou
109870: Turning Mecard stars Jason, a grade-schooler who meets a Mecanimal, a transforming minicar from the alternate world of Triforce, named Evan. Jason and Evan are both searching for missing family members, and team up to help each other. Together, they meet more Mecanimals as they battle across dimensions and learn important lessons along the way.
110318: In a world where magic is everything, Asta, who is the only person who can't use magic, and the magical genius Yuno go all out to become the Wizard King. This is a spin off of the anime series "Black Clover" with an unbelievable story and an amazing cast.

In un mondo in cui la magia è tutto, Asta, che è l'unica persona che non può usare la magia, e il genio magico Yuno va tutto per diventare il Re Mago. Questo è uno spin off della serie anime "Black Clover" con una storia incredibile e un cast incredibile.
110382: A short series released on the web, featuring the cast as mini characters.
110446:
In 2030, Japan. A virus has infected humans throughout the world. Infected people turn into different forms of monsters based on their ages, sexes and races. The virus is named ‘Gibia’ - after being rich in variety like gibia.

Just then, a pair of samurai and ninja appeared in such a blighted wasteland of Japan. They both travelled from the early Edo period, fighting together with help from a doctor who tries to find cure for Gibia. Facing ceaseless attacks from Gibias, and outlaws that attack travellers for food, they start the dangerous journey with enemies all around.

Nel 2030, in Giappone. Un virus ha infettato umani in tutto il mondo. Le persone infette si trasformano in diverse forme di mostri in base alle loro età, sessi e razze. Il virus si chiama

Proprio allora, un paio di samurai e ninja apparvero in una terra desolata del Giappone. Entrambi hanno viaggiato fin dai primi anni di Edo, combattendo insieme con l'aiuto di un medico che cerca di trovare una cura per Gibia. Affrontando gli attacchi incessanti da Gibias, e i fuorilegge che attaccano i viaggiatori per il cibo, iniziano il pericoloso viaggio con i nemici in giro.
111790:
First exhibited at Jump Festa 2020.

In the Miyagi Prefecture qualifiers for the Spring Tournament, Karasuno High School Volleyball Team manages to defeat Shiratorizawa Academy in an intense battle and secures their spot in the national tournament. Meanwhile in the Tokyo qualifiers, Nekoma High School, Fukurodani High School, Nohebi Academy, and Itachiyama Academy fight for the 3 slots to go to nationals.

Will Nekoma High School be able to secure their spot in the tournament? Will we able to see a rematch of Nekoma and Karasuno's Battle of the Garbage Dump on a national level? The Tokyo qualifiers are about to begin!!

La prima mostra al Jump Festa 2020.

Nella Prefettura di Miyagi per il Torneo di Primavera, Karasuno High School Volley Team riesce a sconfiggere Shiratorizawa Academy in un'intensa battaglia e assicura il loro posto nel torneo nazionale. Nel frattempo nelle qualificazioni di Tokyo, Nekoma High School, Fukurodani High School, Nohebi Academy, e Itachiyama Academy lottano per le 3 slot per andare a nazionali.

La Nekoma High School sarà in grado di garantire il loro posto nel torneo? Riusciremo a vedere una rivincita della battaglia di Nekoma e Karasuno della Spazzatura a livello nazionale? Le qualificazioni di Tokyo stanno per iniziare!!
112302:
"One day, we're going to make the strongest battery ever!" Based on the promise to reunite with Hikaru again, Daigo has moved on to Fuurin Academy Middle School. Daigo is the captain for the baseball club, but with all the older students gone, the team is all girls, including Mutsuko. With a group of peculiar newcomers, the new Fuurin Academy baseball club is off to a new start!

How strong are these baseball girls?! It's the beginning of the "middle school chapter" of the endlessly passionate baseball tale!

"Un giorno, faremo la batteria piu' forte di sempre!" Sulla base della promessa di ritrovare Hikaru, Daigo si è trasferito alla Fuurin Academy Middle School. Daigo è il capitano del club di baseball, ma con tutti gli studenti più grandi andati, la squadra è tutte ragazze, compreso Mutsuko. Con un gruppo di nuovi arrivati, il nuovo club di baseball Fuurin Academy è partito per un nuovo inizio!

Quanto sono forti queste ragazze del baseball?! E' l'inizio del capitolo della scuola media della storia del baseball infinitamente appassionata!
112686: Ryo and Ango are banished from the community for their actions and Team Summer A's remaining members also condemn them and choose to stay. Meanwhile, Hana has survived but is lost and on her own. Ryo and Ango come across Summer B and hesitantly join their group.

Ryo e Ango sono banditi dalla comunità per le loro azioni e i membri rimanenti del Team Summer A li condannano e scelgono di rimanere. Nel frattempo, Hana è sopravvissuta, ma è persa e da sola. Ryo e Ango si imbattono nell'estate B e si uniscono con esitazione al loro gruppo.
113262:
An old couple live in a Japanese village. They make blooms for living. They have been together for life and work for a long time. Recently the husband noticed the wife has had some symptoms of the disease, which caused some obstacles in their work.

Graduate Work 2012 from Aya Tsugehata, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation.
114030: Since ancient times, shrine maidens who wield swords have been exorcising "aratama," strange existences that threaten the human world. These young women who wear school uniforms and a sword are called "Toji," and they serve as an official unit within the police force as a "special religious service police squad." The government authorizes the Toji to wear swords and serve as government officials, and the government has set up five schools throughout the country for the girls to attend. In the spring, the five schools send their best Toji to compete in a tournament. As the tournament comes closer, all of the representatives rigorously train themselves in order to get stronger and improve their skills.
114606: On their way home from high school, Tamahi and some classmates are shocked as they witness someone fall from the rooftop of nearby apartment. Panicked and confused, they rush to the building only to find it deserted. As Tamahi wonders about this, she has the uneasy feeling they are being watched. What is the strange presence around her…
114862: It’s been a year since Shiroe and his friends were trapped in Akiba due to the Catastrophe. Their forging of the Round Table has brought order and prosperity to its people. But fracturing political alliances and the constant menace of the Genius monsters threaten to destabilize all they’ve fought for and built. Can faith be restored and they persevere, or is its destruction truly inevitable?

È stato un anno da quando Shiroe ei suoi amici sono stati intrappolati in Akiba a causa della Catastrofe. La loro formazione della Tavola Rotonda ha portato ordine e prosperità alla sua gente. Ma frazionando alleanze politiche e la minaccia costante dei mostri Genius minacciano di destabilizzare tutto ciò per cui hanno combattuto e costruito. La fede può essere ripristinata e perseverare, o la sua distruzione è veramente inevitabile?
114926: The racing never ends! Return to the world of Jet Racing and catch up with Rin and Misa in the Kandagawa Jet Girls OVA.
115438:
A girl is kept on the trot by a witch and continues to peel potatoes. She is fed up and tries to escape in vain. She gets desperate and decides to beat the witch... After all what will she find? What is her intention? Can we undo what has been done?

Graduate Work 2011, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation
115758: Continuation of Glass no Kamen Desu ga under a new name and director. The delinquent concept was dropped and the series depicts the cast in various funny situations, some referencing the original manga and other famous works.

Neo Kyoto is now a city in ruins, looking nothing like it did before. The people are being rounded up by the King's servants, known as KUGE, and deposited into "Barrels" to steal their magical power. All in order to keep the King going...

After his father's death and the destruction of his village at the hands of English raiders, Einar wishes for a peaceful life with his family on their newly rebuilt farms. However, fate has other plans: his village is invaded once again. Einar watches helplessly as the marauding Danes burn his lands and slaughter his family. The invaders capture Einar and take him back to Denmark as a slave.

Einar clings to his mother's final words to survive. He is purchased by Ketil, a kind slave owner and landlord who promises that Einar can regain his freedom in return for working in the fields. Soon, Einar encounters his new partner in farm cultivation—Thorfinn, a dejected and melancholic slave. As Einar and Thorfinn work together toward their freedom, they are haunted by both sins of the past and the ploys of the present. Yet they carry on, grasping for a glimmer of hope, redemption, and peace in a world that is nothing but unjust and unforgiving.

Dopo la morte di suo padre e la distruzione del suo villaggio per mano dei predatori inglesi, Einar desidera una vita pacifica con la sua famiglia nelle loro fattorie di nuova costruzione. Gli invasori catturano Einar e lo riportano in Danimarca come schiavo.

Einar si aggrappa alle ultime parole di sua madre per sopravvivere. È acquistato da Ketil, un gentile proprietario di schiavi e padrone di casa che promette che Einar può riconquistare la sua libertà in cambio di lavorare nei campi. Presto, Einar incontrerà il suo nuovo partner nella coltivazione di fattoria...Thorfinn, uno schiavo sconvolto e malinconico. Mentre Einar e Thorfinn lavorano insieme per la loro libertà, sono perseguitati sia dai peccati del passato che dagli stratagemmi del presente. Eppure essi continuano, aggrappandosi a un barlume di speranza, redenzione e pace in un mondo che non è altro che ingiusto e spietato.

Who is the new mastermind who is sneaking up in order to frame Keigetsu...?

The gratifying tale of switched fates brought to you by two girls who are polar opposites—the curtain rises on the second act, "The First Royal Outing" Arc!

Il secondo cour di Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den.

Attraverso le azioni di Reirin e Keigetsu, la serie di disordini causati da una maledizione nella corte interna si sono calmati.

Attraverso il loro scambio, Reirin e Keigetsu hanno imparato l'un l'altro personaggio di tonner, e un'amicizia stava germogliando tra loro due.

Passano le stagioni, e ora siamo all'inizio dell'autunno. Il luogo del rituale dove il Principe ereditario e le fanciulle desiderano un raccolto generoso (il Festival della Vendemmia) è stato ambientato all'interno delle terre meridionali governate dal clan Shu. Senza consorte come tutore, Keigetsu continua arduamente con i preparativi nonostante senta la pressione come ospite della Festa del Raccolto. Nel frattempo, Reirin sostiene di tutto cuore Keigetsu mentre è entusiasta della sua prima escursione reale.

Tuttavia, proprio all'arrivo, si verifica un incidente imprevisto e il rituale viene interrotto. Un incantesimo di Keigetsu agitato e' fuori controllo, e lei ancora una volta scambia i corpi con Reirin. Inoltre, tra tutte le confusioni, il post-swap Reirin viene rapito...!?

Reirin ha due fratelli iperprotettivi Kou Keikou e Kou Keishou coinvolti e la situazione si dirige in una direzione inaspettata.

Chi è la nuova mente che si sta intrufolando per incorniciare Keigetsu?

Il racconto gratificante dei destini cambiati portati a voi da due ragazze che sono opposte polari si alza la tenda sul secondo atto, "The First Royal Outing" Arc!
